question: An investigator is studying muscle contraction in tissue obtained from the thigh muscle of an experimental animal. After injection of radiolabeled ATP, the tissue is stimulated with electrical impulses. Radioassay of these muscle cells is most likely to show greatest activity in which of the following structures?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Radiolabeled ATP injection" -> "ATP uptake by muscle cells" -> "Muscle contraction" -> "Greatest activity in Z line" -> 95% CHAIN: "Radiolabeled ATP injection" -> "ATP breakdown for energy" -> "Muscle contraction" -> "Greatest activity in Z line" -> 90% CHAIN: "Radiolabeled ATP injection" -> "ATP hydrolysis for cross-bridge cycling" -> "Muscle contraction" -> "Greatest activity in Z line" -> 95%
analysis: During muscle contraction, ATP is utilized for energy. The area where the greatest activity of ATP utilization would occur is where the actin and myosin filaments overlap, known as the A band.
